record.one_liner: Adobe Commerce (Magento) provides REST APIs authenticated via standardized OAuth 2 protocols, including support for server-to-server and user authentication flows.

auth_methods.quote: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service REST API authentication is handled through Adobe's Identity Management System (IMS) through standardized OAuth 2 protocols.
